science: A change in approach-distance or velocity composition between matched photoperiod branches may generate apparent season×solar-phase detection interactions even when animal encounter time distribution and distance-specific camera detection efficiency are invariant.

frozen_axes.calendar_pairs: Same 41 original Uljin 2022 matched astronomy dates, only hypothetical one-site two-bin comparison scored; not opening original animal events.

methods.pooled_reference_naive: Pool near and far reference successes in each solar-season cell and compute 4 simultaneous Clopper-Pearson q intervals with calibration alpha .025; treat 50/50 reference distance mix as if it transferred. Animal Fisher test uses alpha .025. This is invalid for target opportunity mixtures that differ.
methods.target_stratified: Estimate q_near and q_far with 8 simultaneous Clopper-Pearson intervals using alpha_q=.0125; estimate four target near-distance opportunity proportions with 4 simultaneous Clopper-Pearson intervals alpha_mix=.0125; animal one-sided exact Fisher alpha=.025; total bounded false certification <=.05 by union bound if both external reference streams correctly represent true passage opportunities.
methods.cp_interval: Two-sided CP using scipy.special.betaincinv at cellwise tail beta=alpha_component/(2 * number_cells); q=0 or n cases are respected.
methods.detector_transport: q_effective[b]=w_target[b] q_near[b]+(1-w_target[b]) q_far[b]; interval min/max obtained by optimizing separately over independent joint interval corners in q and w.
methods.test: One-sided exact conditional Fisher tail P_theta(X>=x) at theta=known_effort_OR*B; reject only p<.025.
methods.reference_opportunities: Near/far independently labeled passages at reference detector with identical sensor settings (n per each 8 branch×bin×distance cells) and independently observed target near/far mixing opportunities (n per each 4 branch×bin cells).
